UK Chancellor John Healey Faces Budget Questions After Labour Conference Speech

UK Chancellor John Healey delivered his first conference speech ahead of next month's Budget, vowing to adhere to fiscal rules while facing pressure to outline how his plans for reindustrialization will be funded. Healey stated that offering jobs to young people is a priority over benefits, a message he conveyed to the Labour faithful. The coverage indicates scrutiny over the financial implications of his vision, with questions raised about where the money will come from to support his initiatives.
